as_told.title: Walker to Steinman: 'I was there. So what?' and known of MJ12 for 40 years

plain: Eric A. Walker, a scientist who was president of Penn State University, is said to have admitted on a phone call with the UFO researcher William Steinman that he knew about Majestic 12, a secret panel said to have handled crashed saucers. Michels links the story to Robert Sarbacher, a scientist whose account described someone like Walker, and the call is also remembered for talk of psi, meaning psychic abilities. Michels says that when Steinman asked Walker directly, Walker said he had known about the group for decades. The UFO researcher Grant Cameron dates the call to 1987 and gives Walker's words: "I was there. So what?" and then, "I've known of them for 40 years. Leave it alone." Cameron says this is what convinced him the story is real, since it would mean a senior insider confirmed the group existed.
